messages.subject: file.choose and fileInput
parts:
I use an actionButton('upload') to allow users to load data when an app is run locally. I would like to keep consistency between the local and server version of the app and so would like something like the below to work. 

if(interactive() == TRUE) {
fpath <- try(file.choose(), silent = TRUE)
} else {
  fpath <- fileInput('file1')
}

fileInput is a ui-element so this won't work. Is there a way to get the browser's file-selection window to be activated after clicking an actionButton if interactive() == FALSE? I realize that fpath would be a dataframe in that case which should be fine.

I could use the fileInput element in both the local and server version I guess but I do like file.choose for local if possible.

messages.subject: Re: file.choose and fileInput
parts:
What if your ui.R had this:

if (interactive() == TRUE) {
  actionButton('upload', 'Upload')
} else {
  fileInput('file1')
}

Then in your server.R:

values <- reactiveValues()
if (interactive() == TRUE) {
  observe({
    if (input$upload != 0) {
      values$fpath <- try(file.choose(), silent=TRUE)
    }
  })
} else {
  observe({
    if (is.null(input$file1) || nrow(input$file1) == 0)
      values$fpath <- NULL
    else
      values$fpath <- input$file1[1,'datapath']
  })
}

Then instead of referring to either file path directly in your application code, refer to values$fpath.
